comments.author: FromTheMovies

replies.author: purri-cat-studio
replies.body:
I already had a lot of assets from work on my RTS game so I just passed that off to Claude along with a list of requirements of what I wanted. 

For better or worse AI is so good now that I'm relegated to being an art director, feature designer, and project manager. Which I don't mind. Anyone who has done UI work or behaviour trees for bots as a hobby will understand how nice it is not to have to do that anymore.

replies.author: purri-cat-studio
replies.body:
Already planning a ranking system and a strategic gameplay mechanics. 

Those who have played WW II Online will know what I'm aiming for... a grim-dark FPS played out on a huge world map where battles have meaning. What Eternal Crusade should have been.
